stem: Which CMDB Health KPI measures whether required CI attributes and relationships are populated?

distractor_notes.B: Correctness measures accuracy, such as duplicates and stale data, not whether fields are populated.
distractor_notes.C: Compliance measures conformance to CSDM standards.
distractor_notes.D: Staleness is a signal of data not being refreshed, a correctness concern.

rationale: Completeness scores whether the attributes and relationships a CI is expected to have are actually populated.

stem: Which CMDB Health KPI is hurt by duplicate or stale CIs?

distractor_notes.B: Completeness is about populated fields and relationships, not accuracy.
distractor_notes.C: Compliance is about CSDM conformance.
distractor_notes.D: Coverage is not one of the three core health KPIs.

rationale: Correctness measures the accuracy of CI data, so duplicates and stale records reduce the correctness score.

stem: Which CMDB Health KPI measures conformance to recommended CSDM classes and relationships?

distractor_notes.B: Completeness is about populated data.
distractor_notes.C: Correctness is about accuracy.
distractor_notes.D: Currency is not a defined CMDB Health KPI.

rationale: Compliance measures how well CIs follow the recommended CSDM classes and relationship structures.

stem: A physical server appears as two CIs. Which health dimension is affected and what remediates it?

distractor_notes.B: Adding fields addresses completeness, not duplicate records.
distractor_notes.C: Reclassifying changes class, it does not merge duplicates.
distractor_notes.D: Time does not resolve duplicate CIs.

rationale: Duplicate CIs are a correctness problem; de-duplication tasks identify and merge or remove them.

stem: In IRE, what does an identification rule determine?

options.text: Whether an incoming CI already exists
Which source may update an attribute

distractor_notes.B: That is the job of a reconciliation rule, not an identification rule.
distractor_notes.C: Install status is a field value, not set by identification rules.

rationale: Identification rules match incoming data against existing CIs to decide whether to update an existing CI or insert a new one.

stem: In IRE, what does a reconciliation rule control?

options.text: Which data source may update an attribute

distractor_notes.B: Duplicate detection is identification, not reconciliation.
distractor_notes.C: Number prefixes are set in Number Maintenance.
distractor_notes.D: Field order is a form layout concern.

rationale: Reconciliation rules govern which data source is authoritative to write a given attribute, preventing lower-priority sources from overwriting it.

stem: Two discovery sources report different values for the same CI attribute. What decides the winning value?

options.text: The most recent manual form edit

distractor_notes.B: Manual edits do not automatically win across sources in IRE.
distractor_notes.C: Roles do not determine attribute precedence.

rationale: Reconciliation rules and datasource precedence determine which source's value is authoritative when sources conflict.

stem: You need periodic attestation that a set of CIs is accurate. Which feature do you configure?

distractor_notes.B: Query Builder finds CIs but does not run attestation.
distractor_notes.C: UI Policies control form fields.

rationale: Data Certification schedules reviews where owners confirm or correct CI data, with follow-on remediation for failures.

stem: Who is primarily accountable for overall CMDB data quality and governance?

distractor_notes.B: A MID Server executes discovery and integrations; it is not an owner role.
distractor_notes.C: A catalog item requests services.
distractor_notes.D: A schedule runs jobs, it is not accountable for quality.

rationale: The CMDB Data Manager role owns CMDB data quality and governance across the platform.

stem: A health scorecard shows low completeness for a CI class. What is the most likely cause?

options.text: Required attributes or relationships are unpopulated

distractor_notes.B: Role counts do not affect completeness scores.
distractor_notes.C: Themes are cosmetic and unrelated.
distractor_notes.D: Class name length does not affect data completeness.

rationale: Low completeness means CIs in that class are missing attributes or relationships the model expects to be populated.

stem: You must stop a low-priority integration from overwriting the 'owned by' field on servers. What do you configure?

options.text: A reconciliation rule for that attribute
A UI Policy on the form

distractor_notes.B: UI Policies affect the form, not which source writes data.
distractor_notes.C: Form views change layout, not write precedence.
distractor_notes.D: Number Maintenance is about record numbering.

rationale: A reconciliation rule restricts which data source may update a specific attribute, blocking unauthorized sources.

stem: What does CMDB Workspace provide?

options.text: A console to manage CMDB health, data, and remediation

distractor_notes.B: Form design is done in the Form Designer.
distractor_notes.C: Themes are unrelated to CMDB management.
distractor_notes.D: CMDB Workspace does not purchase hardware.

rationale: CMDB Workspace is an administrative console for monitoring health, managing data, and driving remediation.

stem: Stale CIs are lowering the correctness score. Which action most directly helps?

options.text: Rediscover or refresh the CIs on a schedule
Add more sections to the form

distractor_notes.B: Form sections do not refresh data.
distractor_notes.C: Renaming a class does not update CI data.
distractor_notes.D: Granting admin broadly is a security risk and does not refresh CIs.

rationale: Staleness is resolved by rediscovering or refreshing CIs so their data reflects current reality.

stem: Which tool visually builds queries across CI classes and their relationships?

distractor_notes.B: Number Maintenance defines record numbering.
distractor_notes.C: Form Designer arranges form fields.
distractor_notes.D: Update Sets move configuration between instances.

rationale: CMDB Query Builder lets you visually query CIs and traverse their relationships across classes.

stem: What does a dependency (BSM) map display?

options.text: A CI and its related CIs, graphically

distractor_notes.B: Roles are managed in user administration.
distractor_notes.C: Schedules are set on data sources or jobs.

rationale: A dependency or business service map graphically shows a CI and the CIs related to it.

stem: You want to run health metrics repeatedly against a fixed set of CIs. What do you create?

distractor_notes.B: A new table is unnecessary and does not scope metrics.
distractor_notes.C: UI Actions add buttons, not CI scoping.

rationale: A CMDB group is a reusable set of CIs you can target with health metrics, certification, and remediation.

stem: In a 'Depends on :: Used by' relationship, which side relies on the other?

options.text: The 'Depends on' side relies on the 'Used by' side
Neither side relies on the other
The 'Used by' side relies on the 'Depends on' side

distractor_notes.B: The relationship explicitly encodes a dependency.
distractor_notes.C: This reverses the meaning of the relationship.
distractor_notes.D: The relationship is directional, not symmetric.

rationale: In Depends on :: Used by, the 'Depends on' CI requires the 'Used by' CI to function.

stem: You suspect duplicate CIs are inflating your counts. Which workflow addresses this?

distractor_notes.B: Form layout does not affect duplicate data.
distractor_notes.C: Numbering is unrelated to duplicates.

rationale: De-duplication tasks detect candidate duplicates and let you merge or remove them.

stem: You need a CI set whose membership updates automatically from a filter. What fits?

distractor_notes.B: An export is a point-in-time copy that does not update.
distractor_notes.C: A snapshot does not refresh membership.

rationale: A dynamic CMDB group derives its membership from a filter, so it updates as CIs change.

stem: What does the CMDB Health dashboard summarize?

distractor_notes.B: Order volumes are a service catalog metric.
distractor_notes.C: MID Server logs are operational logs.

rationale: The CMDB Health dashboard summarizes the completeness, correctness, and compliance of CMDB data.

stem: Which Discovery phase determines the type or class of a detected device?

distractor_notes.B: Scanning detects that a device is present and reachable.
distractor_notes.C: Exploration gathers detailed attributes after identification.
distractor_notes.D: Identification matches to an existing CI or creates one.

rationale: Discovery runs scanning, classification, identification, then exploration; classification determines the device or CI type.

stem: Which Discovery phase gathers detailed attributes and relationships?

distractor_notes.B: Scanning only detects active devices.
distractor_notes.C: Classification determines the type.
distractor_notes.D: Identification matches or creates the CI.

rationale: Exploration is the final Discovery phase, collecting detailed attributes and relationships for the identified CI.

stem: What executes Discovery and integrations on the local network?

distractor_notes.B: The browser renders the UI, it does not run discovery.
distractor_notes.C: UI Policies control form fields.

rationale: The MID Server runs on the local network and executes Discovery probes and integration work on behalf of the instance.

stem: You must load CI data from a third-party CMDB without writing custom integration code. What is recommended?

distractor_notes.B: Manual entry does not scale and is error-prone.
distractor_notes.C: UI Actions add buttons, not integrations.

rationale: Service Graph Connectors are prebuilt, IRE-based integrations for loading third-party CI data into the CMDB.

stem: In the import pipeline, what stages incoming rows before transformation?

distractor_notes.B: The target table is the final destination.
distractor_notes.C: The transform map maps staged rows to the target.
distractor_notes.D: The data source defines where data comes from.

rationale: The import set table is a staging area that holds raw incoming rows until a transform map loads them.

stem: Ingestion keeps creating duplicate CIs. Which mechanism should prevent that?

distractor_notes.B: MID Server size affects throughput, not matching.
distractor_notes.C: Themes are cosmetic.

rationale: IRE identification rules match incoming data to existing CIs so updates occur instead of duplicate inserts.

stem: You need to transform external data and load it into the CMDB through identification. Which tool maps and loads via IRE?

distractor_notes.B: Form Designer builds form layouts.
distractor_notes.C: Number Maintenance defines numbering.

rationale: IntegrationHub ETL maps source data to CMDB classes and loads it through IRE for identification and reconciliation.

stem: What is the base table that all configuration items extend?

distractor_notes.B: task is the base for tasks like incidents, not CIs.
distractor_notes.C: sys_user stores users.

rationale: cmdb_ci is the root CI table; all specific CI classes extend it.

stem: Where are relationships between CIs stored?

distractor_notes.B: cmdb_ci stores the CIs themselves.
distractor_notes.C: sys_relationship defines relationship types, not CI links.

rationale: CI-to-CI relationships are stored in cmdb_rel_ci, linking a parent and child CI with a relationship type.

stem: You move a generic Computer CI to the more specific Linux Server class. What is this called?

distractor_notes.B: Coalescing matches import rows to records.
distractor_notes.C: Transformation maps imported fields.

rationale: Moving a CI to a different class (more specific, less specific, or a different branch) is reclassification.

stem: Which tool centralizes managing CI classes, attributes, identification, and relationship rules?

distractor_notes.B: Form Designer arranges form fields.
distractor_notes.C: Update Sets move configuration between instances.

rationale: CI Class Manager is the single place to view the class hierarchy and manage attributes, identification, and relationship rules.

stem: Several sources write to one CI and you need to see which source set each value. What enables this?

distractor_notes.B: UI Policies control form fields.
distractor_notes.C: Themes are cosmetic.

rationale: Multisource CMDB tracks attribute values per data source, so you can see which source provided each value.

stem: Which CSDM domain holds core reference data like companies, locations, and users?

distractor_notes.B: Design captures business and application services.
distractor_notes.C: Operate uses the model for events and incidents.

rationale: The Foundation domain holds the core reference data (companies, locations, users, groups) the other domains build on.

stem: Which table stores business applications?

distractor_notes.B: cmdb_ci is the base CI table.
distractor_notes.C: service_offering stores service offerings.

rationale: Business applications are stored in the cmdb_ci_business_app table within the CSDM Design domain.

stem: You need to model a running instance of an application and its supporting CIs. Which CSDM construct fits?

distractor_notes.B: A service offering is a committed level of a service, not the running instance.
distractor_notes.C: A location is foundation data.

rationale: An application service represents a running instance of an application together with the CIs that support it.

stem: Leadership wants services modeled before mapping technical CIs. Which CSDM domain captures the service blueprint?

distractor_notes.B: Foundation is core reference data.
distractor_notes.C: Operate is operational use of the model.
distractor_notes.D: Ingest is not a CSDM domain.

rationale: The Design domain captures business and application services as the service blueprint, before technical mapping.
